the self-test body loads when its pane first opens (issue #1013) a teardown during the load builds nothing into the discarded tree
why: Issue #1013. The self-test's body loads when its pane first opens, and the resolved load stops checking whether its generation is still current. A close during the load then builds the body into the closed pane, a close and reopen builds two bodies side by side, and a teardown builds into the tree it discarded -- the generation guard the issue asks for, modelled on the gallery mount in `route-ui.ts`, gone.
